item.title: India’s internet ad market to more than double to $13.06 billion by 2029: Report
item.description: PwC India’s latest Global Entertainment & Media Outlook 2025-29 forecasts strong growth for the country’s entertainment and media (E&M) sector, projecting expansion from $32.2 billion in 2024 to $47.2 billion in 2029. The 7.8% compound annual growth rate (CAGR) is nearly double the global average of 4.2%. item.description: House of Communication has been appointed to handle nationwide public relations for PropertyPistol, a technology-enabled real estate advisory platform. The mandate includes strengthening stakeholder perception, expanding media visibility across key markets and supporting the company’s next phase of growth. item.title: Vinod Intelligent Cookware announces Chef Nehal Karkera as digital ambassador
item.description: Vinod Intelligent Cookware has named Chef Nehal Karkera as its digital ambassador for the next year. He is expected to lead a series of digital and on-ground initiatives aimed at engaging Millennial and Gen Z home cooks. Chef Karkera will front campaigns featuring the brand’s key product lines and will participate in branded recipe integrations, workshops in cities such as Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Delhi and Mumbai, and creator-driven content across YouTube and Instagram. item.title: Print ad space grows 3% in Jan-Sept 2025 as education & auto lead: Report
item.description: India’s print advertising market recorded a 3% rise in ad space in January-September 2025 compared with the same period last year, according to new data from TAM AdEx. The report shows sustained activity across sectors, with education, auto and services emerging as the top contributors. The education sector led print advertising with a 17% share, followed by auto at 16% and services at 15%. Banking/finance/investment accounted for 11%, while retail captured 8%. item.description: Project Worldwide has opened its India/South Asia ‘Project Hub’ in Bengaluru, bringing together several of its agencies under one integrated operational centre. The move is part of the holding company’s global rollout of multi-agency collaboration hubs already established in New York, London, Singapore and Sydney. item.description: Dream11 has shifted its focus from gaming to a global second-screen sports entertainment platform aimed at enhancing how fans engage with live events. The company, in a statement, said the revamped platform will offer creator-led live match watch-alongs, interactive reaction and banter features, and free-to-play fantasy sports. item.title: Instagram adds new metrics and tools for marketing API
item.description: Instagram has rolled out several updates to its API suite, adding new performance metrics and expanding tools for content management and collaboration. The platform introduced five new metrics to its Insights endpoint, including Reels Skip Rate, which measures the percentage of viewers who skip a reel within the first three seconds. The update also includes repost counts for individual media, repost counts at the account level, and Instagram profile visits for advertisers using the Marketing API

item.title: Meta rolls out new support hub and AI security tools
item.description: Meta announced new support features and security updates for Facebook and Instagram, including a centralised help hub and expanded use of artificial intelligence to prevent account hacks. The company said a new support hub is being introduced across both apps for iOS and Android. The hub brings together troubleshooting tools in one place, allowing users to report account issues and search for quick answers using Meta’s AI-powered search. The rollout is global.
